title: The Crossing Point: where an individual's own record beats their reference class
description: Pilot measurement of the IREP premise on 69 seasons of the Lahman Baseball Database. At what amount of individual evidence does a subject's own record beat their reference class out of sample, and how far is that point from the classical shrinkage prediction sigma2_w/sigma2_b. Hypothesis-generating; hypotheses frozen for a confirmatory second domain (see PREREGISTRATION.md section 0). One command from raw download to figures.
